# IMMUNOGLOBULIN DEFICIENCY (HUMORAL IMMUNE SYSTEM)

Antibody deficiency typically leads to recurrent, severe respiratory tract infections associated with encapsulated bacteria, especially Streptococcus pneumoniae and Haemophilus influenzae, and to a lesser extent, Staphylococcus aureus. Recurrent otitis media, sinusitis, and pneumonia are common syndromes.
Gastrointestinal disease associated with Salmonella, Shigella, Campylobacter, or rotavirus is also common in some patients.

[References](references)
Rich RR, et al, eds. Clinical Immunology
Roitt I, et al, eds. Immunology
Therapy:
## Preferred empirical treatment

Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h ($5.71/day) [M]

## Alternative for severe penicillin allergy

Chloramphenicol is not currently available. Contact Infectious Diseases for advice.
